messages:
Jo (DevEx): quick check-in on the compact run-history + function defs layout. I prototyped a stacked compact card for mobile/side-by-side panes. goal: keep tool-call affordances visible without scrolling. attaching png.
Priya (Design): looked at the png. love the compact cards but worried about discoverability of required params. suggestion: show a collapsed pill '2 req' and on focus expand inline, not navigate to drawer.
Alex (Eng): inline expand is doable. small caveat: the animation needs to avoid layout shift for the runlist; we should animate height only and avoid reflow of sibling nodes.
Ben (PM): also want the run-history to surface failures faster. can we include a tiny status dot with hover text: 'validation error' -> expands to inline summary?
Noor (A11y): accessibility notes: 1) the '2 req' pill must be keyboard focusable and have aria-expanded when it reveals params. 2) contrast of the pill needs to meet 4.5:1 in high-contrast mode.
Jo (DevEx): agreed. proposal: pill gets role=button, aria-expanded=false by default, pressing Enter toggles inline param row. aria-live region announces 'calculateShipping: 2 required parameters visible'.
Priya (Design): microcopy: for the pill tooltip: '2 required parameters — press enter to reveal'. keep the tooltip short.
Alex (Eng): on implementation side, i recommend debouncing the schema validation indicator updates (200ms) and not recalculating visibility counts on every small edit. we'll compute diffs and emit a lightweight event for the UI.
Ben (PM): analytics here: event names: run_history.expand_param_pill, run_history.copy_signature, run_history.error_inspect. props: fn_name, project_id, error_type. we can use these later to tune Optimize suggestions.
Noor (A11y): copy affordance: when user activates 'copy signature', we should set clipboard to plain text and then set role="status" aria-live message: 'Copied signature for calculateShipping to clipboard' so screen reader users get feedback. avoid relying on visual toast alone.
Jo (DevEx): good point. i'm also suggesting that when a param is auto-filled from previous run, we show a subtle inline tag 'from last run' and announce it with aria-describedby on focus.
Priya (Design): visual idea: when a function has tools attached (tool-calling enabled), show a stacked icon row (tool, webhook, db) so users recognise it's a tool-callable function at a glance. make icons 16px and use token spacing.
Alex (Eng): small perf note: rendering icons per card is cheap but we should virtualize run-history list for large projects. otherwise DOM churn will kill scroll.
Ben (PM): roadmap ask: tie run-history copy clicks to docs onboarding. if we see lots of copy events but low runtime calls, maybe users are trying CLI first and failing. could be a friction signal.
Noor (A11y): another nit: when the inline param row opens, focus should move to the first required input. pressing Escape collapses and returns focus to the pill. keyboard-only users lose context otherwise.
Jo (DevEx): actionable list: 1) Priya to deliver compact card + pill mock with focus states (a11y variants) by Tue. 2) Alex to implement pill toggle, aria-expanded, debounced validation diffs, and telemetry hooks by end of sprint. 3) Noor to prepare a short a11y checklist for run-history interactions (focus order, live regions, contrast). 4) Ben to add analytics events and link to Optimize hypothesis doc.
Priya (Design): will include a high-contrast token example and two microcopy variants: short and verbose.
Alex (Eng): question: clipboard copy — add small copy icon or rely on long-press menu on mobile?
Jo (DevEx): both. show icon on desktop, long-press action on mobile. ensure we expose 'Copy signature' in context menu for touch.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy: playground-compact-runlist v0.3 -> staging at 02:30 UTC.
Ben (PM): quick follow-up: update release notes blurb to mention 'improved run-history compact view, keyboard-first param reveal, and accessible copy affordances'.
Noor (A11y): test plan reminder: run voiceover and talkback passes for the compact runlist flow, plus keyboard-only walkthrough.
Jo (DevEx): great. i'll update the spec doc with aria examples and the analytics contract. thanks all :rocket:
